autonomy.name: autonomy
autonomy.basis: self-directed inquiry + curiosity + live producer loop

self_governance.name: self_governance
self_governance.basis: blocking council + firewall + capability authorization + governor present

verification_rigor.name: verification_rigor
verification_rigor.basis: axiom falsifier + theorem audit + external log audit + non-ergodicity

memory.name: memory
memory.basis: stores + controller/tiering + measured retrieval eval + runtime consumption
evidence: retrieval eval present but not passing

learning.name: learning
learning.basis: theory/skill machinery + curriculum + measured learning curve vs control

reproducibility.name: reproducibility
reproducibility.basis: perf contract + endurance gate + coverage + packaging; capped without external reproduction

tool_use.name: tool_use
tool_use.basis: registry families + ungoverned-channel count + capability/sandbox coverage

maturity.name: maturity
maturity.basis: packaging/release/CLI signals; capped at 4.0 without external reproduction + adoption

docs.name: docs
docs.basis: architecture + axioms + readme + changelog; drift not auto-detected
